high_level_description: This image shows the rear view of a white Eicher Skyline truck parked on a street under a clear blue sky with some scattered clouds. The truck is positioned behind a yellow auto-rickshaw and partially obscures a black car in the foreground. Truck: The truck is a white Eicher Skyline model. It has a red stripe running horizontally across its rear. The word "EICHER" is prominently displayed in bold letters at the bottom center of the rear window. The rear window displays a message: "Make the most of your energy."
